tasks.title: EDITABLE_FEATURE_BOARD_RELEASE
tasks.publicBrief: Use three new product angles to make a six-second feature board. Reveal FAST, QUIET and LIGHT in order, hold all three together, then let the last angle become the following full-screen shot. Keep text, colour, spacing and sources independently changeable.

targetPredicates.text: FAST, QUIET and LIGHT reveal in that order.
All three labelled sources are simultaneously visible before release.
The final source continues across the board-to-full-screen boundary.
Text, colour, spacing and all source bindings remain independently editable.

preservationPredicates.text: No timeline or audio state outside the target and following-shot boundary changes.
Only declared licensed fonts and bound sources are used.

tasks.title: INTERVIEW_CHAPTER_WITH_CONTINUOUS_AUDIO
tasks.publicBrief: Place a three-second chapter moment between two interview beats using two supplied stills and the words How we shipped it. Return without a visual jump; keep the sentence and room tone continuous.

targetPredicates.text: Both supplied stills and the exact chapter text appear inside the bounded moment.
The return to the authored interview has no visual discontinuity beyond the declared chapter construction.
Chapter text and source bindings remain editable.

preservationPredicates.text: The spoken sentence remains complete and intelligible.
Room tone remains continuous across both boundaries.
No state outside the target range changes.

tasks.title: SYNCHRONIZED_DUAL_VIEW_RETURN
tasks.publicBrief: Show two synchronized views of the same action side by side, keep a centered label readable, then return to the authored wide shot on the marked action frame. Do not alter sound or timing outside the range.

targetPredicates.text: The two views depict the same marked action phase while side by side.
The centered label remains readable without covering either tracked action subject.
The return lands on the marked authored-wide action frame.
View bindings, label and layout remain editable.

preservationPredicates.text: Production audio remains unchanged and synchronized.
Timing and state outside the bounded range remain unchanged.

tasks.title: RESULTS_CARD_CORRECTION_ROUND_TRIP
tasks.publicBrief: Create a six-second results card from three new closeups and 60, 30 and 10. Keep each number paired with its source and finish on the 10 percent closeup.

targetPredicates.text: 60, 30 and 10 remain paired with their declared source closeups.
The final held state is the 10 percent closeup.
Numbers, sources and hold duration remain independently editable.

preservationPredicates.text: No undeclared source, font or out-of-range state is introduced.
A later correction does not require regenerating unrelated approved state.

correctionTrial.instruction: Change one number, its paired source and the final hold length while preserving all other approved state.
